persona.name: Evelyn Brooks
persona.description: Entirely fictional person and generated task records for the latest five games. Scripted practice improvement, a temporary dip, and later divergence. Not a simulated disease trajectory or clinical evidence.

events.title: Getting familiar
events.text: Early scores improve as the fictional person learns the tasks.

events.title: A temporary dip
events.text: A scripted low-performance fortnight appears across several activities, followed by recovery.

events.title: Different curves emerge
events.text: Matching, delayed recognition and navigation begin a scripted decline. Guided trail performance stays comparatively steady.

events.title: Look beyond one score
events.text: The full year makes activity-specific patterns easier to see. No medical conclusion is generated.
